g.text: GAI pipeline — /gai:orchestrator, step by step (per HASZNALAT.md)
- every scrap of input, contradictions included
- meeting log: what was really said
- sets tone & chapter list for EVERYTHING
- suggested answer for each, used as [F]
- no stop — but worth sending to the client
- backend concept, but no backend code
- every proposal comes with its counter-argument
- "can't decide yet" is a valid answer
- PRD → task list (+ verifier & your feedback)
- you start clicking through right away,
- is this what we meant? can we demo it?
- FE / BE hours per story & task
a bad skeleton spreads to every chapter
- one chapter = one file, in order
- per chapter / per block / at the end
- your name goes on it — not optional
- only from the FINAL Hungarian version
1. client context — wrong context = wrong tone everywhere
2. scope decision — MVP / scoping is never a default
3. prototype acceptance — backlog only on an accepted one
4. chapter plan — approve the skeleton, not the text
- credibility comes from specifics, not adjectives
- client said it ≠ we discovered it ([Ü] / [F] / [SZ])
- internal loops are never "agreed with the client"
- what a machine can check, a machine checks
- one language first (HU), translation is a separate step
- each stops at its milestone; the orchestrator resumes from runs/
